_comment: Copy to config.json in this directory and set 'host' to the registered DuckDNS hostname.
The TLS certificate and key sit alongside it. Nothing here is secret, but server-key.pem is —
mTLS terminates in this process. ca_file is deliberately omitted: fleet-telemetry embeds
Tesla's production CA (//go:embed files/prod_ca.crt) and uses it by default, so there is no
CA file to fetch or keep current. server_cert/server_key must be a publicly trusted
certificate for the hostname registered in fleet_telemetry_config — issued over DNS-01
because nothing answers HTTP on that name.

records._comment: Only vehicle data ('V') is forwarded to the controller; the rest is logged locally.

_comment: Binds on all interfaces so the controller container can subscribe by service name. The port
is not published to the host, so it stays inside the compose network.
